changelog: Fixed SIGSEGV double-free in CPedModelInfo::DeleteRwObject -> CColModel::~CColModel on server disconnect/restart (custom 0.3.DL skins now keep m_pHitColModel=nullptr so SetClump creates a dedicated hit-col instead of sharing basePed->m_pHitColModel)

Cleared both bDoWeOwnTheColModel (bit 5) and bOwnsCollisionModel (bit 11) on borrowed collision models, prevented recycling still-referenced custom slots during Reset(), and removed noisy MaterialTextGenerator::Generate1..8 synchronous FLog spam
